name: @json2video/cli
stderr:
Usage: json2video [options] [command]

JSON2Video CLI - Create videos programmatically

Options:
  -V, --version                      output the version number
  -h, --help                         display help for command

Commands:
  auth [options]                     Set up and manage API key authentication
  render [options] [file]            Submit a movie JSON for rendering
  status [options] <project>         Check rendering status of a project
  account [options]                  Show account info and quota usage
  templates [options]                List your templates
  templates-library [options]        List featured templates from the library
  template [options] <id>            Get details of a template (name,
                                     description, expected variables)
  template-save [options] [file]     Save a movie JSON as a template in your
                                     account (create, or update with --id)
  validate [options] [file]          Validate a movie JSON locally without
                                     rendering
  examples [options] [id]            List and fetch example movie JSONs
  docs [options] [topic] [subtopic]  JSON syntax reference: elements,
                                     properties, voices, components, and more
  mcp                                MCP server management: run, install,
                                     uninstall
  media                              Manage media files (upload, list, get,
                                     delete)
  skill                              Manage AI skills: install, update, list
  help [command]                     display help for command
